statements.status_notes: The vulnerable AVI parser is a Windows-specific code path that Debian does not build into its binary packages, as documented in the Debian tracker notes: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-5673. The Linux libtheora libraries shipped in this image therefore do not contain the vulnerable code.
